items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Richards, the “Cuban Fire” album... [INTERVIEWEE] A lot of great writers.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was an organizer and he presented and provided a vehicle for the players and the arrangers. He knew how to find the right arrangers for his music. The Bill Holmans, the Gerry Mulligans, the Bill Russos, Bill, I mean what’s his name, Johnny—
Richards, the “Cuban Fire” album, which is a collector’s item.
